# Copilot Instructions for english-learning

Use this repository as a Laravel project with a strict spec-to-deploy workflow.

## Default workflow

For any feature, bugfix, or refactor, follow the workflow in `workflows/spec-to-deploy.md`.

## Required Superpowers skills

- Use `brainstorming` when the request is unclear, broad, or needs design trade-offs.
- Use `writing-plans` after the spec is approved and before any implementation.
- Use `test-driven-development` for all behavior changes and bug fixes.
- Use `verification-before-completion` before claiming work is done.
- Use `finishing-a-development-branch` when the work is complete and ready to merge, PR, keep, or discard.
- Use `using-git-worktrees` when isolation is needed before implementation.
- Use `subagent-driven-development` or `executing-plans` when carrying out a written plan.

## Project rules

- Keep changes minimal and aligned with existing Laravel conventions.
- Prefer real tests over manual verification.
- Do not skip a phase just because the change seems simple.
- If verification fails, fix the code or the spec before moving forward.
